title: etbb-july-2024-february-2026-update.pdf — section 356
text:
348 has determined that the terms “woman”, “man” and “sex” in the
EqA 2010 refer to a person’s biological sex. Woman has always meant biological woman. Man
has always meant biological man. Sex has always meant biological sex. See the Equality Act

2010 appendix for an overview of the EqA 2010 and more detail of the application of the EqA

2010 to “sex”.

348 For Women Scotland Ltd v The Scottish Ministers [2025] UKSC16.
